$comment: Authoritative model licence registry. See docs/00 ADR-2.
`verify-licenses` fails the build when MODEL_TIER=production and any
model with commercial_ok:false is reachable. Adding a model here without
a licence review is the failure mode this file exists to prevent.

models.name: SAM 3D Body (ViT-H)
models.commercialNote: Grant is 'non-exclusive, worldwide, non-transferable and royalty-free' with no commercial carve-out and no MAU threshold. Restrictions are acceptable-use (no weapons/ITAR/espionage), publication attribution, and passing the licence along with redistributions.

models.name: SAM 3D Body (DINOv3-H+)
models.commercialNote: Commercial OK. Uses the DINOv3 backbone, which carries its own DINOv3 License (also commercial, no MAU cap) REQUIRING a visible 'Built with DINOv3' attribution in the product. Ship both licenses. Verified 2026-09-08.

models.name: Momentum Human Rig
models.commercialNote: Apache 2.0. Independently licensed from SAM 3D Body, so the body model survives any change to the estimator's terms.

models.name: Anny
models.commercialNote: Apache 2.0, ungated (`pip install anny`). Provides interpretable phenotype parameters. Supports all ages; we deliberately restrict to 18+ (docs/06 §6.2).

models.name: BiRefNet
models.commercialNote: MIT. Chosen over RMBG-2.0 (non-commercial) and SAM2 (requires prompts; we want zero user input).

models.name: xatlas
models.commercialNote: MIT. UV atlas is precomputed once per body topology and cached — never per job.

models.name: Mock adapter
models.commercialNote: Deterministic fixtures. Lets the full pipeline run in CI with no GPU and no weights.

models.$comment: ──── BELOW THIS LINE: NOT SHIPPABLE. Research tier only. ────
models.name: PSHuman
models.commercialNote: BLOCKED. Depends on SMPL-X: non-commercial, and additionally forbids training networks for commercial use — so derived weights are contaminated, not merely dependent. Requires >40 GB VRAM at 768px (24 GB at 512px), so it cannot run on the 8 GB dev GPU regardless. Meshcapade acquired by Epic Feb 2026; future terms unknown.

models.name: LHM-0.5B
models.commercialNote: BLOCKED. Highest reported quality (25.18 PSNR / 0.951 SSIM) but SMPL-X derived. Note PSNR measures novel-view appearance, not metric body accuracy — its lead is in the layer we treat as disposable.
